stories.title: ‘We are human too’: the Roma film-makers striking back at stereotypes

A different kind of drama - the visually-impaired actors creating pictures through sound
stories.summary: An audio drama workshop has brought blind and partially-sighted people together to create a new play. A box of gravel, a handful of leaves and a miniature door might not sound like the ingredients for a wedding day drama. But in a room filled with people experimenting with sounds, they are helping to bring an entire world to life. For a group of blind and partially-sighted people, an audio-based drama workshop is giving them the chance to explore performance - without relying on visual cues. Instead, they are using sound to create characters, settings and stories, building a picture in the audience's mind without showing them a single image.

stories.summary: The LPGA is adding more fines in addition to stroke penalties for players in 2027 for slow play The policy for the timing method and stroke penalties is the same, but more fines have been added. In the past, each time a player finished one to five seconds over the allotted time, it was a warning, and now it will be a fine in 2027. If a player finishes six to 15 seconds over, it previously was a one-stroke penalty and now a fine is added. If a player's time is 16 seconds or more over the allotted time, it's still a two-stroke penalty but now also a fine.
